purpose: preservation of the pre-adoption telemetry corpus; no metric computed
era_assigned_by: log stream, never timestamp — the rolling deploy overlapped
caveats: The pre_msw path corpus is heavily synthetic: one journey at each consecutive bypass_depth from 26 to 46, plus clusters at exactly 50 and 100, are a script walking one press at a time rather than use.
193 of the pre_msw path events fall on 2026-07-28 alone.
Some post_msw events are a session's own deploy verification (a Radiohead -> Miles Davis journey pressed five times), not owner use.

The two eras differ in MORE than the graph: the owner's usage pattern changes deliberately after adoption (the queued test asks for ten or more 'known' presses), and the deploy moved several knobs at once. A before/after difference is NOT attributable to any one of them.
